decision.summaryForCoordinator: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody holds: sha256 474a019d… as expected, mode 0444, unmoved at start and at end. Every digest the draft cites resolves byte-exactly against live bytes, and an independent re-resolution of all 27 file-backed recordedInputs entries inside harness v4 returned 27 matches, 0 mismatches, 0 missing, with the top-level head, recordedInputs.HEAD and git HEAD all 443d951 and file08Pin equal to live file 08. Both Stage A verdicts are ACCEPT 0/0 and both are mode 0444. Live standing is exact on every recital: required-now 28 of 28, owners 32 of 32, condition 4 MET, condition 2 at 4 of 32, condition 5 not started, DR-G18 live at file 08 line 354 with lead token OPEN and named at D-086, DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, last gate row DR-G32, last COORD heading D-215 with no D-216 heading yet written. The two leftover sets match live bytes: [OBL-G18-FX-AUTHORING] on G18 at leftover-join.v4 (D-193) and [OBL-G18-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-ENCODING-RESERVED] on DR-107 at lifecycle leftover-join.v3 (D-176), with neither flipped, closed, nor stolen. The shared class is recited correctly and both identifiers CLAUDE-G18-V3-B1 and CODEX-G18-V3-SF1 are preserved and verified landed in the occupancy bytes; CLAUDE-G18-V1-B1 is verified still retained at EV-5; the complete open lineage set is exactly those three and the draft recites all three. Claude Stage A's three observations are verified identifier-free and the draft mints no identifier for them; Codex Stage A raised none. The non-unwrite span enumerates all 49 entries D-167 through D-215 with D-168 present, no gaps and no duplicates. The gate-row sentence is byte-identical to seven prior gate-row drafts and does not claim that D-056 gates 2 and 3 fail. Nothing is marked SATISFIED, Class A is not opened, QUALIFIED is not pinned, no DR-G* row is added, required-now is unchanged, file 08 is untouched, and docs/v2/implementation/ is not authorized. Thirty-two attacks were run and all thirty-two were refuted. Three items are recorded as observations, not findings, and none of them is a bar to adoption.
